import-csv.verified_behavior: Import CSV login and secure note with multiline notes/custom field and normalized folder ancestors; fresh-login decryption verified.

archive-item.verified_behavior: Archive one encrypted item through the bulk route and decrypt after fresh-cache sync.

list-archived.verified_behavior: Local cache archive visibility and decryption after sync; does not prove an HTTP list endpoint.

api-key-login.verified_behavior: Environment-only BW_CLIENTID/BW_CLIENTSECRET; locked login then password unlock/sync/decryption, fresh-cache login, old-key rejection after rotation and new-key login. No API-key value is passed in process arguments or diagnostics.

create-attachment.verified_behavior: Official CLI encrypts empty, all-byte and2MiB+37 files, including quoted Unicode filename; Direct v2 reserve+multipart upload.

delete-attachment.verified_behavior: CLI removes attachments; HTTP checks all four aliases and verifies old capabilities cannot return deleted bytes.

get-fingerprint.verified_behavior: Authored official CLI flow compares a nonempty cached me fingerprint to the same account UUID lookup without printing either value. Both120-command runs pass against no-warden and Vaultwarden1.37.4; catalog presence is not a request trace.
